description: Provides mentorship and transition support to U.S. Army 75th Ranger Regiment veterans and their families, covering employment, finances, education, and family wellbeing, and supports the families of fallen Rangers through its Gold Star program.
Publishes free, ad-free self-improvement articles and guidance on topics like personal finance, relationships, and personal development, aimed at adults seeking practical life-skills education.
notes: Web content is a general self-help publishing site with no visible Yamhill County program; categorized per its adult-education NTEE code (B60).

description: A Carlton-based foundation, formed in memory of Oregon watercolor artist Lynn Powers, that promotes fine-art access in underserved Oregon communities and operates the WALLOW virtual-reality art gallery.

displayName: Yamhill County Mounted Sheriff's Posse Foundation
description: Supports the Yamhill County Sheriff's mounted posse, a volunteer horse-mounted unit that assists with search and rescue, patrol, and public events in McMinnville.
Raises funds and community support for the Yamhill County Sheriff's Office, supplementing equipment, training, and community safety programs.

Operates a naturopathic clinic in Newberg providing individualized, whole-body natural healthcare, including diagnostics, physical exams, and specialized programs such as brain health and fertility preparation.

Runs a drop-in center in Newberg connecting people experiencing homelessness, mental health challenges, and substance use issues to food, warmth, emergency shelter, and pathways to housing and recovery.
Raises charitable funds to support patient care programs, equipment, and services at Providence Newberg Medical Center.

Provides child-centered, weight-neutral nutrition education to families in Yamhill County through medical appointments, cooking classes, and community events, tailored to each family's cultural and economic needs.
A coordinated care organization that manages Oregon Health Plan (Medicaid) funding and services for Yamhill County residents, coordinating physical, dental, and behavioral health care.

notes: Public records show a Solana Beach, CA operating address alongside the Newberg, OR mailing address; the organization may be only nominally connected to Yamhill County.

description: Unites Asian Americans in Yamhill County, preserves local Asian American history, and promotes Asian social and cultural activities in the McMinnville area.

notes: Source data lists aka 'Newport Celtic Fest & Highland Game,' but the organization's own website and its McMinnville city listing point to a McMinnville-based Scottish Festival & Highland Games; the aka may be outdated or mismatched.

description: A Newberg-based chapter of the Society for the Preservation and Appreciation of Antique Motor Fire Apparatus in America, dedicated to restoring and preserving historic fire engines and equipment.

The McMinnville-area chapter of the Daughters of the American Revolution, promoting historic preservation, education, and genealogical research related to the American Revolution.

A small museum in Sheridan, Oregon that preserves and shares local history through exhibits and community outreach.

An educational and public service organization that protects, preserves, and shares the history and heritage of Yamhill County through exhibits and events.
